findings.problem: Source-gap/unresolved placeholder returns enter cross-sectional training ranks and refits as observed labels.
findings.evidence: Original synthetic annual fold admitted 2 unresolved rows. After repair zero unknown labels reach training/refit and unknown test candidate is retained.
findings.required_action: Exclude only unknown training labels; keep validation and test candidates feature-defined; filter unknown labels from IC; retrain final ML2.

findings.problem: Manual terminal return was anchored to formation close and returned unchanged for next-session execution. Lag-one entry also used forward-filled stale prices.
findings.evidence: Formation close 100, actual next-session entry 110, payout 110: old return +10%, repaired actual next-close and next-open both return 0%.
findings.required_action: Use actual execution-day quote, rebase known terminal wealth to actual entry; no real entry stays unresolved; rerun affected execution variants.

findings.problem: DSR trial Sharpes and winner input use nominal net returns; shared deflated_sharpe expects excess returns.
findings.required_action: Subtract date-matched rf for all trial Sharpes and winner DSR. Recompute statistics after final returns.

findings.problem: SPEC section 7 requests removing largest-contribution stock and best year as sensitivity diagnostics; no such computation is present in current run output path.
findings.required_action: Either compute these diagnostics without candidate/parameter expansion or explicitly disclose their absence. Existing CAGR is not invalidated by absent diagnostics.

findings.problem: ANDV and SCG manual stock-merger terminal values use successor month-end close approximations, not a fully observed successor next-session open path. Cash-payout rebasing alone does not prove exact open-to-open liquidation.
findings.required_action: Preserve explicit terminal approximation label or obtain verified successor execution evidence; do not silently call all terminal returns exact open-to-open.

findings.problem: Available liquid non-S&P pool is incomplete, especially dead firms after 2018; sectors and security identities use partial reconstruction/heuristics.
findings.required_action: Report coverage and survivor/identity limitations. Missing-terminal stress on present names cannot measure omitted-firm survivorship bias.

findings.problem: Generic delisted-in-month fallback still used next-close entry even with an observed entry open.
findings.evidence: Actual next-open 90, next-close 110, last trade 121: old +10% versus correct modeled terminal return +34.4444%. Repaired 5-status x 4-open-availability matrix passed independently.
findings.required_action: Rebase known last-trade terminal wealth to actual entry open. Keep unresolved/source-gap status unknown. Final training must follow this fix.
